detail.longDescription: hey HN, I started to get tired when I had to switch from Claude on one computer to Gemini on a different computer for a single project that ran in sync on multiple machines. it got really annoying to the point where I developed agent-comms, a zero-dependency tool that can handle coordination between different agents working on the same or different physical machines async or sync (real-time). take a look at the repo linked above and please leave any feedback, thanks!
